final: WITH group_averages AS (SELECT e.link_to_budget, b.event_status, AVG(e.cost) AS average_cost FROM expense AS e JOIN budget AS b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY e.link_to_budget, b.event_status), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_cost) AS overall_average FROM group_averages) SELECT g.event_status, AVG(g.average_cost), AVG(g.average_cost - o.overall_average) FROM group_averages AS g CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.overall_average IS NOT NULL AND g.average_cost > o.overall_average GROUP BY g.event_status
